summary: Ambiguous tag namespace causing partial credit reassignment on monthly invoice
description:
Issue summary:
Customer reports that ~18% of their monthly "credits" allocation applied as part of our reserved-hours smoothing were missing from their finalized invoice for Feb 2026. BridgeLane noticed a negative provisional balance and an unexpected line item charging hosted fallback rates for ~23k tokens.

Impact:
- Customer sees an extra charge of $1,164 on finalized invoice for billing period 2026-02-01 to 2026-02-28.
- Affects production workloads for BridgeLane (dedicated account).
- Immediate business impact: paused non-critical batch inference jobs and engaged Finance for dispute.

Environment:
- Account: bridge-lane-prod (dedicated)
- Region: us-east-1
- Services involved: postback-reconciler (hourly), tag-normalizer, billing-aggregator, console estimate API.

Steps to reproduce (as performed by Support):
1) Pulled hourly postback stream for account bridge-lane-prod between 2026-02-01T00:00:00Z and 2026-02-28T23:59:59Z.
2) Filtered for events with "billing_tag" present. Found ~4,400 postbacks with ambiguous tag values (examples below).
3) Replayed a subset through local reconciler (staging) with current tag-normalizer v1.3.1 and also with patched v1.4.0 to compare ledger attribution.
4) Observed ~18% of affected postbacks attributed to cost_center "bridge-lane-staging" rather than "bridge-lane-prod" in reconciler v1.3.1; patched v1.4.0 attributes them correctly.

Observed payload snippets (sanitized):
- original_postback: {"api_key":"REDACTED","usage_tokens":452, "billing_tag":"env:prod;team=search"}
- normalized_v1.3.1 -> tags: ["env", "prod;team=search"] -> cost_center resolved: bridge-lane-staging
- normalized_v1.4.0 -> tags: ["env:prod", "team=search"] -> cost_center resolved: bridge-lane-prod

Logs / evidence:
- S3 export: s3://billing-exports/2026/02/bridge-lane-postbacks-02.csv (internal link)
- Reconciler trace: trace_id=rec-20260221-77a0 (link in investigation notes)
- Console estimate snapshot (customer): screenshot attached in ticket (not included here).

Customer notes:
- BridgeLane (CS contact: Tanya Moreno) confirmed they did not change client-side tags during the period. They use an internal CI that sets billing_tag="env:prod" consistently.

Desired outcome from customer:
- Immediate ledger correction for Feb invoice and provisional balance reversal.
- A patch to prevent recurrence and a short postmortem.

Investigation notes:
- Hypothesis 1: tag-normalizer v1.3.1 splits on punctuation and treats colon as separator; it then concatenates segments incorrectly when semicolons are present. This behavior was introduced as part of an earlier robustness change for legacy tags.
- Hypothesis 2: reconciler's cost_center resolution logic matches normalized tag tokens against a lookup table; partial tokens yielded fallback to staging cost center due to name overlap (bridge-lane-stag vs bridge-lane-prod).
- Reproduced locally: replay of 1,000 affected postbacks using v1.3.1 produced 180 misattributions to staging; v1.4.0 (patch) produced 0 misattributions.
- Root cause: tag-normalizer relied on regex "[,:;\\s]+" to split tags, which collapses "env:prod" into ["env", "prod"], but when input contained embedded semicolons without expected spacing the second token concatenated with following token in edgecases (implementation bug in token join path).
- Secondary effect: billing-aggregator dedupe step aggregated these misattributed lines into final invoice without cross-check for cost_center drift.

Actions taken so far:
- Support replayed affected postbacks through patched reconciler in staging and generated corrected ledger lines for verification.
- Finance notified; provisional hold placed on dispute (ticket raised FIN-88521).
- Temporary manual credit ledger created for BridgeLane to restore provisional balance pending automated fix.

Next steps (short-term):
1) Patch deployment: roll tag-normalizer v1.4.0 to production (includes unit test covering colon+semicolon edgecases). PR: github.com/redwood-inference/tag-normalizer/pull/76.
2) Run targeted reconciler replay for account bridge-lane-prod for the full Feb window and produce corrected invoice delta.
3) Apply manual ledger adjustment and issue invoice credit; confirm with customer.
4) Add reconciler check that flags cost_center drift > 5% within same hourly window as a failed assertion (alerts to #billing-ops).

Longer-term follow-up (postmortem):
- Complete postmortem with root cause, timeline, and mitigation (confluence page link above).
- Add end-to-end test harness for postback pipelines using representative tag payloads from large customers.
- Consider schema validation on client postbacks with stricter field definitions for billing_tag.

Resolution notes (pending):
- Manual ledger credit prepared for $1,164 and queued for Finance approval.
- Patch v1.4.0 ready and flagged for canary in us-east-1; target production rollout 2026-02-24 03:00 UTC after canary pass.
- Owner for follow-up postmortem: Marco Ortega (SRE) and Priya Shenoy (Billing).

SRE (Marco Ortega) - 2026-02-21: Confirmed reproducible misattribution in local replay using tag-normalizer v1.3.1. Created fix branch and unit tests. Raised PR #76 for tag-normalizer. Will coordinate canary.
Billing (Priya Shenoy) - 2026-02-22: Preparing manual adjustment workflow. Need commit from SRE that reconciler replay output matches finance format. Opening FIN-88521 for audit trail.

resolution: Pending production rollout and formal ledger correction. Manual provisional credit prepared for $1,164 and Finance notified. Patch v1.4.0 validated in canary (us-east-1). Full replay and invoice delta scheduled for 2026-02-24. Postmortem draft to follow.
